author: Sarah Law
content: Fantastic service and a really friendly team. I ordered 14000 balls for my birthday party and it was by far the best party I've ever had. The balls were clean; delivery and collection were prompt; they very kindly moved them to where I wanted them in the house; and the price was very reasonable. And they also sent a follow up email to check everything was good and that I had a good party! Would absolutely reccommend.
